wire.settings.account_policy.label: account selection policy
wire.settings.account_policy.help: Chooses eligible sibling accounts within the same provider and credential tier. A compatible, unexpired lease from a successful request takes priority for every policy; it does not guarantee a cache hit. Reset soonest prefers the nearest weekly refill, then the five-hour refill within one-minute ties. An explicit policy overrides the legacy usage-aware account pick setting.
wire.settings.account_policy.reset_soone: Prefer the nearest included-plan reset; spread ties and unknown reports deterministically. Default for new configurations.
wire.settings.account_policy.headroom.de: Prefer cached remaining quota, spreading accounts within ten percentage points of the best.
wire.settings.account_policy.fair.label: Fair spread
wire.settings.account_policy.fair.descri: Use a stable session-based spread instead of ranking cached resets or remaining quota.
wire.settings.account_policy.legacy.help: Compatibility setting, used only when account selection policy is absent: true selects Most headroom; false selects Fair spread. An explicit account selection policy takes precedence. Reset the account selection policy row to restore Reset soonest and clear legacy overrides.
wire.settings.account_policy.error.write: The setting could not be saved. Check configuration permissions on this computer and try again.
